article.title: Domicile of origin of illegitimate child.
article.content:
8Domicile of origin of illegitimate child.

Section 8  ·  Part II  ·  page 18 of the Act
The domicile of origin of an illegitimate child is in the country in which, at the time of his birth, his mother was domiciled.
